_comment: Curated ESP32/ESP-IDF security advisories from Espressif's own vulnerability disclosure (docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/.../security/vulnerabilities.html). Silicon-vendor source #4 for the AES RAG corpus. Only ESP-IDF-applicable entries are included (chip/port-N/A ones omitted). To refresh: re-scrape that page or the GHSA advisory links. Severity is a qualitative class label (vendor page lists no CVSS); 'score' is left N/A rather than fabricated.

advisories.title: WPS Enrollee Fragment Integer Underflow
advisories.description: An integer underflow while processing WPS enrollee fragment messages can cause out-of-bounds memory access during Wi-Fi Protected Setup provisioning, potentially leading to memory corruption or denial of service from a crafted WPS frame.

advisories.title: BluFi Example Memory Overflow
advisories.description: A memory overflow in the BluFi reference application: a crafted BluFi frame over BLE can corrupt device memory during Bluetooth-based Wi-Fi provisioning, potentially exposing Wi-Fi credentials or enabling code execution.

advisories.title: ESP-NOW Integer Underflow
advisories.description: An integer underflow in ESP-NOW packet handling can trigger out-of-bounds read/write from a crafted ESP-NOW frame, leading to memory corruption or denial of service on devices using the ESP-NOW protocol.

advisories.title: AES/CBC Constant IV in ESPTouch v2
advisories.cwe: CWE-329 (Generation of Predictable IV with CBC Mode)
advisories.description: ESPTouch v2 uses a constant (static) initialization vector with AES-CBC, weakening encryption of provisioning data and allowing an on-path attacker to recover plaintext such as Wi-Fi credentials.

advisories.title: Bootloader TOCTOU in Anti-rollback Scheme
advisories.description: A time-of-check to time-of-use flaw in the bootloader anti-rollback scheme lets an attacker with flash access bypass anti-rollback and boot a downgraded, vulnerable firmware image. Directly relevant to OTA update integrity (Solution 1).

advisories.title: Bypass of Secure Boot and Flash Encryption via EMFI
advisories.description: Electromagnetic fault injection (EMFI) on ESP32 chip revisions v3.0/v3.1 can bypass Secure Boot and Flash Encryption, enabling extraction of encrypted firmware and secrets given physical access.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2023-005.

advisories.title: Bluetooth BLUFFS Session-Key Downgrade
advisories.description: The BLUFFS vulnerability weakens Bluetooth BR/EDR session-key negotiation, letting an attacker force short or known session keys to perform machine-in-the-middle or impersonation attacks on paired devices.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2023-010.

advisories.title: PEAP Phase-2 Authentication Bypass (wpa_supplicant)
advisories.description: A flaw in PEAP Phase-2 authentication allows a client to skip server authentication, letting an attacker impersonate an enterprise Wi-Fi network and capture user credentials when the supplicant is misconfigured.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2024-003.

advisories.title: ESP-BLE-MESH Stack Buffer Overflow
advisories.description: A buffer overflow in the ESP-BLE-MESH provisioning stack: a crafted Provisioning PDU can overflow a buffer, leading to denial of service or remote code execution over Bluetooth Mesh.

advisories.title: BadAlloc — Integer Overflow in Memory Allocation
advisories.description: Part of the BadAlloc family: an integer overflow during memory allocation can wrap an allocation size and produce an undersized buffer, leading to heap overflow and potential remote code execution.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2021-005.

advisories.title: BadAlloc — Integer Overflow in Memory Allocation
advisories.description: Part of the BadAlloc family: an integer overflow in an allocation path can yield an undersized buffer, leading to heap corruption and potential code execution on affected ESP-IDF builds.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2021-005.

advisories.title: Bluetooth BR/EDR Stack Out-of-bounds (BrakTooth family)
advisories.description: Malformed LMP/baseband packets can trigger out-of-bounds access in the ESP32 Bluetooth BR/EDR stack, causing crashes or potential code execution. Umbrella advisory covering multiple related Bluetooth CVEs.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2021-004.

advisories.title: lwIP Stack Buffer Overflow
advisories.description: A buffer overflow in the lwIP TCP/IP stack can be triggered by crafted network input, leading to denial of service or memory corruption on networked ESP devices.
advisories.resolution: Fix cherry-picked; available in ESP-IDF >= v4.4.1.

advisories.title: lwIP Stack Buffer Overflow
advisories.description: A second buffer overflow in the lwIP TCP/IP stack reachable from crafted network input, with denial-of-service or memory-corruption impact on networked ESP devices.
advisories.resolution: Fix cherry-picked; available in ESP-IDF >= v4.4.1.

advisories.title: WLAN FragAttacks — Plaintext Frame Injection
advisories.description: Part of the FragAttacks set: flaws in Wi-Fi frame aggregation/fragmentation handling let an attacker inject plaintext frames, potentially bypassing network protections.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2023-008.

advisories.title: Wi-Fi Authentication Bypass
advisories.description: A Wi-Fi authentication-bypass condition can be induced on ESP devices, allowing forced disconnect or association-state manipulation by a nearby attacker.
advisories.resolution: Apply mitigations in Espressif advisory AR2020-002.
